prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your needs. A few quick questions so I can recommend right companies for you:

- Is this residential or commercial interior painting?  
- How many rooms / approx. square footage?  
- Any special needs (high ceilings, trim/cabinet work, lead paint, quick timeline, color consult)?  
- What’s your zip code or neighborhood in St. Louis?

In the meantime, here are the easiest ways to identify the best painter for your job:

- Check recent Google/Yelp/Angie’s List reviews and look for consistently high ratings + recent jobs.  
- Confirm insurance (general liability) and ask for proof.  
- Ask for references and photos of recent similar interior jobs.  
- Get at least 3 written estimates that break out prep, number of coats, paint brand/finish, and cleanup.  
- Ask about surface prep (patching, sanding, priming), protection of floors/furniture, and how they handle trim/cutting-in.  
- Confirm warranty/guarantee and cleanup policy, and get all details in a written contract.  
- Prefer painters who offer color consultation and sample patches before full painting.

If you want, I can pull together a current list of top-rated interior painters in St. Louis (with ratings, pros/cons, and what customers say) — tell me your zip code and any must-haves and I’ll research it.
